title: 공군미사일방어사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:32561:20220401:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum <Presidential Decree No. 32561, April 1, 2022>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Part of the Regulations on the Organization of Military Courts shall be amended as follows:
In the column for military courts of general jurisdiction receiving trial support from the Second Division of attached Table 3, "Air Force Air Defense Guided Missile Command" shall be replaced with "Air Force Missile Defense Command".
(2) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 13 (1) 1 (c), "Commander of the Air Force Air Defense Guided Missile Command" shall be replaced with "Commander of the Air Force Missile Defense Command".
In Article 14 (1) 3 (a) and (b), "air defense guided missile units" shall in each case be replaced with "missile defense units".
In the column for Air Force positions in attached Table 1, "Commander of the Air Force Air Defense Guided Missile Command" shall be replaced with "Commander of the Air Force Missile Defense Command".
Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes and Regulations)
Where other statutes or regulations in force at the time this Decree enters into force cite the previous Decree on the Air Force Air Defense Guided Missile Command or any provisions thereof, and corresponding provisions exist in this Decree, the citations shall be deemed to refer to this Decree or the corresponding provisions hereof in place of the previous Decree or provisions.
